title: Xiaohongshu comments.json
description: One note's comment thread, as `collect.py` and `--comments-only` write it into <noteId>/comments.json. The completeness block is part of the contract: the web view only ever renders the rows it has loaded, so a reader has to be told whether the thread was read whole, cut short on purpose, or truncated by the page. The comment container's own text is deliberately not stored — it duplicates every body at ten times the size.

noteId.description: The note this thread belongs to, so the file stands on its own.

declaredTotal.description: The "共 N 条评论" counter the page prints, replies included. Null when the note shows no counter.

requested.description: The top-level comment budget this read was given. A read that stopped at the budget is a truncation the caller asked for, not an incomplete read.

repliesCollected.description: Every reply at every depth, over all top-level comments.

threadEnded.description: The page's own "- THE END -" marker was seen, which settles completeness outright.

noComments.description: The note shows its empty state — it has no comments, rather than a thread that failed to load.

possiblyIncomplete.description: True only when the read stopped before the budget for a reason the page did not explain.

items.description: Top-level comments, each carrying its own replies. A comment and its whole subtree count as one against `requested`.

index.description: Position among its siblings, from 1. The top-level comment has no `depth`; it is what the numbered rows hang from and counts as depth 0.

text.description: The body, without the time/likes/reply chrome around it.

pinned.description: The page marks this comment 置顶评论.

byAuthor.description: The page marks this comment 作者.

replyCount.description: Size of this comment's whole reply subtree, so a thread's row count is `collected` + the sum of the top-level `replyCount`s.

replies.description: Direct replies. Xiaohongshu renders every reply of one comment as a flat sibling row, so this tree is rebuilt from the `回复 X ：` prefix the page prints — never from the DOM.

depth.description: Reply levels below the comment being read: a direct reply is 1, a reply to that reply is 2.

replyTo.description: The person this reply answers, from its `回复 X ：` prefix. Null for a direct reply to the comment itself.

replies.description: Replies to this reply, same shape all the way down.
